title: A KSDS with two alternate keys, one unique and one WITH DUPLICATES, each reached by its own PATH DD
shapes: AIXA AIXAKS2: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS CUS-TAX / ALTERNATE RECORD KEY IS CUS-NAME WITH DUPLICATES
AIXA jcl/AIXADF2.jcl IDC020: DEFINE ALTERNATEINDEX ... UNIQUEKEY and DEFINE ALTERNATEINDEX ... NONUNIQUEKEY, one DEFINE PATH and one BLDINDEX for each
AIXA jcl/AIXARU2.jcl KS2030: //CUSKSD on the base cluster, //CUSKSD1 on the TAX path, //CUSKSD2 on the NAME path
asserts: The SELECT is one file_control fact (select CUS-FILE, assign CUSKSD, organization INDEXED, access_mode DYNAMIC, record_key CUS-ID) with alternate_keys [{name CUS-TAX, duplicates false}, {name CUS-NAME, duplicates true}], in source order: the flag is per key, not per file. Step IDC020 of AIXADF2 holds seven jcl_utility_cards facts, utility IDCAMS: verb DEFINE for the cluster, for each ALTERNATEINDEX (the CUS-TAX one UNIQUEKEY, the CUS-NAME one NONUNIQUEKEY) and for each PATH, then two BLDINDEX, each continued with a trailing hyphen. Step KS2030 of AIXARU2 has four jcl_dds facts: CUSKSD on PROD.AIXA.CUST, CUSKSD1 on PROD.AIXA.CUST.TAXPATH and CUSKSD2 on PROD.AIXA.CUST.NAMPATH; the DDs name the paths, never the alternate indexes.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference (SC27-8713-03)
citations.quote: If the DUPLICATES phrase is not specified, the values contained in the ALTERNATE RECORD KEY data item must be unique among records in the file.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference (SC27-8713-03)
citations.quote: If the DUPLICATES phrase is specified, the values contained in the ALTERNATE RECORD KEY data item can be duplicated within any records in the file.

citations.doc: z/OS DFSMS Access Method Services Commands (z/OS 2.5.0)

notes: The UNIQUEKEY|NONUNIQUEKEY citation is the syntax line, not prose (the parameter page was too large to fetch); the pairing of UNIQUEKEY with a key without DUPLICATES is the standard IBM practice, not a rule quoted here.

jcl_utility_cards.operands: ALTERNATEINDEX (NAME(PROD.AIXA.CUST.TAXAIX) RELATE(PROD.AIXA.CUST) KEYS(9 8) UNIQUEKEY UPGRADE CYLINDERS(1 1))
ALTERNATEINDEX (NAME(PROD.AIXA.CUST.NAMAIX) RELATE(PROD.AIXA.CUST) KEYS(20 17) NONUNIQUEKEY UPGRADE CYLINDERS(1 1))
